tasks.short: Select and obtain course materials and supplies

steps.what: Find actual political-science textbooks/materials and inspect catalogue, edition, availability and supply information
inputs: actual course needs and existing material requirements
actual library/supplier catalogue records
outputs: teacher-read candidate materials and supply information

steps.what: Select actual materials and supplies for the course, checking scholarly fit, accessibility, edition and affordability
inputs: teacher-read candidate materials and supply information
actual course objectives and student access constraints
outputs: teacher's selected materials and required quantities/access

steps.what: Complete and check the actual material/supply requisition with catalogue identity, quantity, access terms and intended purchasing recipient
inputs: teacher's selected materials and required quantities/access
actual catalogue edition/identifier, price and permitted budget
outputs: complete checked material requisition and purchasing recipient

steps.what: Submit the completed checked material/supply requisition to the intended internal purchasing recipient
inputs: complete checked material requisition and purchasing recipient

steps.what: Obtain the actual supplied materials or access and verify edition, quantity and usability for the course
inputs: submitted actual material requisition
actual delivered materials or library/e-book access
outputs: actual obtained and checked course materials/supplies

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue/edition links in {OTHER}, the library/material catalogue, and fixed item fields in {PROCUREMENT}. The teacher selects appropriate actual resources, checks the requisition before internal submission and verifies real delivery/access; purchasing authorisation and supplier fulfilment stay in their existing processes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation and fixed edition/identifier entry can interrupt obtaining course materials.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue fields can reuse actual item identities in a requisition.
tasks.still_hard: A textbook's academic fit and usable student access require assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Reject an apparently suitable title whose edition or access terms fail the course.

ambition.what: No automatic purchasing decision or extra budget authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for library/purchasing access and responsible procurement consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue fields can reduce material-request handling while academic selection and actual receipt checks remain teacher work.

assumptions: Shares describe unmeasured teacher work in a real requisition-and-receipt route, not a measured procurement baseline.

Libraries/suppliers produce actual title, edition, identifier, price and access records; the teacher supplies actual course need and quantities. New item capture and missing fields remain counted in s1/s3.
Only navigation and fixed reference entry change. Equivalent current fields remove the gain; scholarly evaluation and all actual receipt/access work remain counted.
Gross provisional saving 3.9 minus 1 hour of catalogue-field upkeep gives 2.9 net. Submission is negligible and fully retained.
Purchasing approval, supplier labour and delivery elapsed time are not teacher labour savings. The teacher checks the exact request/recipient in s3 and edits void the gate.
unknowns: Actual procurement route and native catalogue fields
research_questions: Does native catalogue reuse reduce actual teacher entry after full edition/access checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect catalogue evidence and complete/check actual requisition

approvals.approved_version: complete checked material requisition and purchasing recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.9%; academic selection and actual obtaining/checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Read actual teaching/research issue evidence and current shared materials needed for the colleague discussion
inputs: actual colleague-raised issue
actual course/research materials and relevant evidence
outputs: teacher-read issue context and evidence limits

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address actual teaching and research issues, comparing interpretations and agreeing practical next actions
inputs: teacher-read issue context and evidence limits
actual colleague concerns and expertise
outputs: actual collaborative discussion and teacher's understanding of next actions

tasks.design: Configure native issue-to-source links in {DOCS} and {LMS} for real discussion preparation. The teacher reads actual evidence and collaborates with colleagues; no extra minutes, task entry or follow-up message is assumed after every colleague conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated retrieval of actual course/research materials can interrupt issue preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can expose the current relevant materials.
tasks.still_hard: Disagreement about teaching or research requires contextual discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Understand a colleague's concern and negotiate a workable response.

ambition.what: No change in colleague authority or collaboration capacity.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native shared-source links can reduce preparation navigation while colleague problem solving remains interpersonal work.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional source-supported issue discussion, not recurring office-hours setup or invented meeting paperwork.
Colleagues raise actual issues and source owners maintain actual materials; teacher reading is counted in s1. Missing evidence is resolved manually.
Only retrieval changes; equivalent current links remove the gain. All actual discussion remains retained and this episode has no required record write or discrete send.
Gross provisional saving 0.75 minus 0.25 hour of source-link upkeep gives 0.5 net. Colleague labour is not counted as teacher saving.
unknowns: Actual preparation evidence and source navigation
research_questions: Does real colleague issue preparation involve repeated retrieval beyond existing links?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.5%; actual collaboration is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read actual department course demand, staffing availability and existing teaching-allocation constraints
inputs: actual departmental course requirements and staff availability
actual allocation rules and existing commitments
outputs: department-head-checked teaching allocation evidence and gaps

steps.what: Determine a workable actual department teaching allocation within academic and staffing constraints
inputs: department-head-checked teaching allocation evidence and gaps
actual academic needs and delegated allocation authority
outputs: department head's proposed teaching allocation and unresolved issues

steps.what: Discuss the actual teaching allocation and resolve administrative issues with department staff
inputs: department head's proposed teaching allocation and unresolved issues
actual staff constraints and concerns
outputs: department head's clarified actual allocation and remaining conditions

steps.what: Complete and check the actual department teaching-allocation record, staff/course identities and unresolved conditions
inputs: department head's clarified actual allocation and remaining conditions
actual staff/course identities

steps.what: Save the completed checked departmental teaching-allocation record within actual department-head authority
inputs: complete checked departmental teaching-allocation record

tasks.design: Configure existing departmental source views in {LMS}, {HCM} and {DOCS}, with fixed staff/course fields in {PROJECT}. The department head decides and discusses the actual allocation, then completes/checks the allocation record before saving; no staff ranking, assignment recommendation or automatic notice is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and fixed identity entry can interrupt actual allocation administration.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and identifier fields can reuse existing course and staff records.
tasks.still_hard: Academic fit, competing duties and staff constraints require fair contextual judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve an allocation conflict that looks feasible on paper but fails in practice.

ambition.what: No extra staffing authority or automatic personnel decision.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-7 for staff/course access and employee consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native staff/course views can reduce handling while academic allocation and staff discussion remain department-head work.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional actual department-head teaching-allocation administration, one administrative duty, not all department-head work or a measured baseline.
Academic administration maintains course needs/identities; staff/HR maintain actual availability. The head checks gaps in s1 and captures/clarifies actual constraints in s2/s3/s4.
Only navigation and fixed identity entry change. No free structured preference feed or inferred staff performance is assumed; equivalent current tools remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 2.7 minus 0.75 hour of source/field upkeep gives 1.95 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.

The head checks final record content in s4 within existing authority. Saving does not approve new employment commitments or send staff notices; existing higher authorisations remain required where applicable.
unknowns: Actual head duties, authority and current allocation tooling
research_questions: Does real teaching-allocation administration repeat source or identity handling beyond native tools?

already_counted.description: Review source availability and complete/check actual allocation record

incremental.description: Maintain departmental source and staff/course fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.95%; actual allocation decisions and staff discussion remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Serve on academic or administrative committees

steps.what: Read actual committee papers on institutional policies, departmental matters or academic issues and assess the evidence
inputs: actual committee agenda and policy/academic papers
actual institutional context and supporting evidence

steps.what: Serve on the actual academic/administrative committee by deliberating policy, departmental or academic issues with other members
inputs: teacher-read committee issues and questions
actual member arguments and institutional constraints
outputs: actual teacher contribution to committee deliberation

tasks.design: Configure native agenda-to-current-paper links in {DOCS}. The teacher reads the actual evidence and deliberates with committee members; this member's policy-discussion episode does not assume that the teacher also writes minutes, submits a policy or records a formal vote.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated current-paper retrieval can interrupt actual committee preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native agenda/version links can expose the actual papers.
tasks.still_hard: Institutional trade-offs and legitimate disagreement require deliberation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain a policy consequence that another member has overlooked.

ambition.what: No change in committee decision rights or automatic policy decision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native committee-paper links can reduce retrieval while academic policy deliberation remains member work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured committee member's actual preparation and deliberation, not invented chair/secretary administration.
Committee owners produce actual agenda/papers; the teacher reads/checks evidence in s1. Missing papers require real manual clarification.
Only retrieval changes; substantive reading and deliberation remain fully retained. Equivalent current links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 1.75 minus 0.5 hour of agenda-link upkeep gives 1.25 net. No separate record, report or discrete send is present in this discussion episode.
A real written contribution, formal vote or secretary record requires its actual separate work and final-version action gate; none is assumed merely to create a saving.
unknowns: Actual committee role and current paper access
research_questions: Does native current-paper linking remove repeated preparation navigation for actual committee members?

already_counted.description: Read actual committee papers and assess evidence

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.25%; actual policy reading and member deliberation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Check scholarly material access and actual requisitions
Use fair administrative and committee judgment
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated source and identity handling while retaining academic selection, departmental decisions and collegial deliberation.
